items.text: Fixed the 'Update now' button: it no longer kicks you out of the app on its own. If the install permission is missing, the app shows a dialog inside the app explaining it, and you choose whether to open Settings. And if a download fails, the button resets instead of staying stuck. Update now.
items.title: App update — the Update button now works inside the app

items.text: Likes and comments now need Google sign-in: tap Like or write a comment and the app will ask you to sign in first, then complete what you tapped right away. And if sign-in has a problem, the app now shows the real error code so it can be fixed. Update now.
items.title: App update — like & comment with Google sign-in

items.text: New TechPulse app update: the Like count now updates instantly the moment you tap — no waiting, and the like is really recorded on your account. You can also sign in with Google: one tap once, then automatic — your likes and comments stay with your account. Update now.
items.title: App update — instant likes & Google sign-in

items.text: New TechPulse app update: the Like button now shows the like count for everyone, and comments now live inside the app under each article — write your comment and read others' without leaving the app. Update now to get the new features.
items.title: App update — shared likes & in-app comments
